extraction.notes: Company does not report an AFFO metric; affo fields set to null. Starting line and FFO/Core FFO totals are shown before the Series D preferred dividend add-back used for the diluted per-share calculation; the diluted share count 18,221 (thousands) reproduces FFO per share $1.11 (20,289/18,221) and Core FFO per share $1.22 (22,265/18,221). Items printed as dashes (loss on extinguishment of debt, technology implementation costs, pursuit costs) are zero in the current quarter and omitted. Recurring capex: the portfolio summary on S-14 shows only a per-apartment-home same-store figure ($491 for three months ended 12/31/2023) with no company total, so recurring_capex_disclosed is null rather than estimated. Core FFO adjustments sum to 1,976 and tie to 22,105; FFO adjustments tie to 20,129.
